name: jobgether-mcp
description: Jobgether (jobs): search. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Job Search API 'for developers and AI agents' (OpenAPI at https://jobgether.com/openapi.json): keyword = free text; locations = 'Location slugs — country, continent, or city (e.g. "spain", "europe", "worldwide"). Unknown values return a 400 error', so pass a lowercase slug as location; page (max 10) and limit (max 25). remoteType/contractType/experience filters are not sent. Hits: id, title, company, url (the Jobgether listing page, not an external apply link), location, remote, contractType, experience, salaryRange, jobFunctions[], postedAt; pagination.hasMore only (no total), so next_page is derived from the page size. Errors are RFC 9457 problem+json.
